about: What this person told voters in each campaign since 2016: their campaign website as saved by the Wayback Machine just before election day (the homepage and the pages about where they stand), as text, and their campaign-season Bluesky and Threads posts. From scripts/collect-campaign-text.mjs; the promises in it are found by step 2.
name: Teresa Leger Fernandez

pages.title: Teresa Leger Fernandez for Congress (New Mexico's 3rd District)
pages.text:
## Together we love our communities, our democracy, and this beautiful place we all get to call home. Ahora es cuando, it’s time now, to take the bold and courageous action to protect what we love.
I am a daughter of rural New Mexico, and I am here to represent New Mexico’s Third Congressional District with a deep understanding of what New Mexico’s communities need.

pages.title: ISSUES | Teresa 4 All
pages.text:
## ON THE ISSUES
"I believe in -- and have spent my life -- building communities. Before I got to Congress, I built rural health clinics, helped start businesses, defended voting rights so everyone’s vote counted, helped families afford a home of their own and worked with Pueblos and Tribal communities across New Mexico. My work in Congress expands upon these experiences, because, when you think about this nation’s aspirational foundation -- the pursuit of happiness and a more perfect union -- what it really comes down to is building thriving, healthy communities."
All Americans deserve to have access to quality, affordable health care in their communities
ECONOMY AND INFRASTRUCTURE
Promote a vibrant, equitable economy. Invest in 21st century infrastructure.
Prioritize education to provide opportunity for all.
PROTECTING OUR LAND, AIR, AND WATER
For generations to come
Protect our communities and families from gun violence.
Strengthening our democracy and fighting to protect the right to vote.
Champion a humane, comprehensive immigration policy.
TRIBAL SOVEREIGNTY AND SELF DETERMINATION
